scope: The eight admission gates named in section 19, the claim renderer named in section 20 line 2, and additional runtime and repository admission gates. This is contract evidence, not a model-quality or release-success claim.

requirements.text: Every gate gets three tests: clean pass, deliberate violation, refuses on nothing.

Every gate has a clean pass, a deliberate violation and an empty-input refusal. This includes source policy, normalization, coverage, proposal schema, predicate verification, approval, publication and report rendering.
Claim renderer and every required gate pass their three cases.

prior_full_check.scope: Existing unchanged contract tests. This historical check does not claim to cover the new assertions.

focused_gate_check.environment_note: TEMP and TMP pointed to the explicitly writable Windows user temporary directory; the default redirected AppContainer temporary directory denied Git initialization.
